final_acceptance.hardware: record per run; same hardware for comparisons
final_acceptance.full_air_transport: requires separate validated dense/3D flow model and included cost; not provided by this DEM baseline

strict_implementation_checks.parallel_later: define_before_implementation; macro tolerances do not excuse missed contacts

baseline_acceptance.known_reference_rejection: mixing_32 at 30 RPM exceeds overlap threshold; retain as diagnostic, never as accurate reference

simplification_acceptance_proposal_froze.group_mass: same numerical mass ledger as baseline; supplied/removed masses explicit
simplification_acceptance_proposal_froze.near_zero_definition: use max(relative tolerance times abs(reference), stated absolute tolerance)
simplification_acceptance_proposal_froze.qualitative: critical clogging/leakage/segregation occurrence must not change; requires separate challenge fixtures before simplification acceptance

fixtures.recipe: optimization_baseline.cpp fixture() versioned by source digest
fixtures.mm_coefficients_note: new virtual test inputs, not a modification or softening of the existing production material
fixtures.small_timing_windows: explicit step count in fixture; too short to certify sustained final target
fixtures.packing: initial close lattice, transient load, not an equilibrated bulk sample
fixtures.discharge: single layer with imposed downward velocity through virtual z=0 collector; not hopper-flow validation
fixtures.mixing: short paddle-contact probe, not a complete mixed product; index remains grid dependent

profiler.scope: ClumpWorld only; nine exclusive phases; pair search/force and mesh query/force grouped to avoid per-contact clock overhead
profiler.failed_attempts: included in counters/time, accepted state unchanged
profiler.overhead: compare solver_call_s with and without profiling; no correction/subtraction from reported times
profiler.memory: peak working set of benchmark child process; includes allocator/output buffers, not per-particle memory or GPU VRAM
profiler.render: Unreal display_sync_cpu measures transform/instance preparation only; no GPU draw measurement claim

current_capacity.larger_requests: unsupported without allocating requested huge arrays; unit test checks actual guard at 301

scope_exclusions: change to contact force or integration
